title: Semantic Contract v1
description: A versioned, machine-evaluated description of what an MCP tool result means. Consumed by the MCP Semantic Contract Omni Gateway policy.

contractId.description: Stable identifier. Appears in metrics and merge ordering, never in injected text.

version.description: Semantic version of the contract content.

description.description: Human-facing note for reviewers. Never injected.

owner.description: Team accountable for the correctness of these rules.

toolMapping.description: Tool names this contract governs. Must be non-empty; a contract bound to no tool is rejected at load time.

id.description: Unique within the contract. Prefixes the guidance line in the injected block and is the merge/dedupe key.

severity.description: Budget drop order is info, then warn. A critical rule is never dropped.

when.description: jsonpath-subset expression evaluated against the bound payload. Mutually exclusive with always. A malformed expression disables this rule only.

always.description: Fire unconditionally on every matched call. Mutually exclusive with when.

guidance.description: The text appended to result.content[]. Never truncated: a rule is injected whole or not at all.

reference.description: Link or ticket justifying the rule. Never injected.
